title: It's possible to create a model that produces Lo-fi versions of songs?
question: The model has to be trained with songs, and the songs must have two versions: one original and the other a Lo-fi remix. Is this possible? (It doesn't have to be based on existing songs, but rather original songs created by the AI developer using Ableton, FL Studio, Logic Pro, etc. The model, however, can still consume existing songs, including famous ones, without explicitly training on them.) If you dont know what I'm talking about, it's like turning this soundtrack: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z6HAakYBKAc Into one that sounds like this one: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-sLRtsRazDQ
answer: It's possible to create a model that produces Lo-fi versions of songs? That task is known as Music Style Transfer. Examples of papers studying that task: A Training-Free Approach for Music Style Transfer with Latent Diffusion Models. https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.15913 Music Style Transfer with Time-Varying Inversion of Diffusion Models. https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.13763
